limits: the formulas are exact identities of the codes' definitions; the check builds every integer up to 2^16 bits; the example uses the prime number theorem's estimate of the millionth prime
name: W3_size_model

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-3

statement: The sizes are predicted without building any integer: the positional and content codes by their logarithmic formulas, within 1.0 and 1 bit of the built integer on all 2223 and 2308 terms small enough to build; the Cantor tree code by carrying log2 up the tree, exact on all 2118 terms whose code was built. The handover's example, 10 tokens over atoms near index 10^6, needs about 9.78e+07 bits as a positional code and 239 as a content code.
